City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 26, 2021 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS

San Dieguito Academy Presentation on Stormwater Quality
4B.
Presentation by Melinda Carmichael Chief Business Development Officer for Home Grown Fun (San Diego County Fair)
4C.
Presentation of Proclamation for National Gun Violence Awareness Day
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the May 3, 2021 Special Meeting, and the May 12, 2021 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-05-26 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Memorandum of Understanding Between the City of Encinitas and iPalpiti Artists International. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam
Approve a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the City of Encinitas and iPalpiti Arts International to provide a music festival for the community from July 15-18, 2021.
2021-05-26 Item 08B MOU Between the City of Encinitas and iPalpiti Artists International
8C.
Authorization to renew Microsoft Exchange and Office product subscriptions. Contact Person: IT Operations Supervisor Contreras
Authorize Office 365 Prop Plus subscriptions in an amount of $150,000 in FY 2021-22; and authorize anticipated Office 365 subscriptions in amounts of $157,700 in FY 2022-23 using Microsoft 365 for U.S. Government pricing which was competitively bid.
2021-05-26 Item 08C Renewal of Microsoft Office and Exchange Subscriptions
8D.
Approval of a Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and Encinitas Environment Day for a community special event at Cottonwood Creek Park. Contact Person: Recreation Services Manager Karlen
1) Approve and authorize the City Manager to execute a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the City of Encinitas and Encinitas Environment Day (EEDAY) in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report in consultation with the City Attorney to host the Eco Fest event on Sunday, September 26, 2021, at Cottonwood Creek Park from 10 a.m. - 4 p.m.; and 2) Approve waiving the application and rental fees for use of the Banquet Room 142, Kitchen, and Patio space at the Encinitas Community Center for the purposes of hosting a pre-event launch reception on Friday, September 24, 2021 from 4-10 p.m.
2021-05-26 Item 08D MOU Between the City of Encinitas and Encinitas Environment Day
8E.
Award of the Moonlight State Beach Concession License Agreement. Contact Person: Management Analyst III Roff
1) Approve the Moonlight State Beach Concession License Agreement in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report; and 2) Authorize the City Manager in conjunction with the City Attorney to execute the Moonlight State Beach Concession License Agreement with Rooster Ramen LLC for three years and nine months commencing upon the date of execution by the City with an option to extend, upon mutual consent, for two additional one- year terms.
2021-05-26 Item 08E Award MLB Concession License Agreement
8F.
Approval of Encina Wastewater Authority Fiscal Year 2021/22 Pension Policy, Operating and Capital Budgets. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
Adopt Resolution No. 2021-36 Approving the Fiscal Year 2021/22 CalPERS Pension Policy, Operating and Capital Improvement Budgets of the Encina Wastewater Authority.
2021-05-26 Item 08F Encina Wastewater FY 2021-22 Budget
8G.
*Amendment to the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for Fiscal Years 2020-21 through 2024-25. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
1) Conduct a Public Hearing related to the proposed projects; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-42, entitled "Resolution of the City of Encinitas Adopting an Amendment to the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for Fiscal Years 2021 through 2025."
2021-05-26 Item 08G Amendment to TransNet Local Street Improvement Program
8H.
Update of City of Encinitas Environmental Policy – C025. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
Approve Updates to the City of Encinitas Environmental Policy – C025.
2021-05-26 Item 08H Update to Encinitas Environmental Policy C025
8I.
Award of contract to CR Associates (CRA), also known as Chen Ryan, for planning services, in an amount not-to-exceed $216,892; and authorize the City Manager to enter into a Professional Services Agreement for the Modal Alternatives Project (MAP) and Active Transportation Plan (ATP) Implementation Plan. Contact Person: Associate Planner Jedynak
1) Approve the Professional Services Agreement with CRA, in an amount not-to-exceed $216,892; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement, including any amendments and time extensions, in substantial form as included in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, subject to review and final approval by City Attorney.
2021-05-26 Item 08I MAP Contract for Chen Ryan Associates
8J.
Adoption of Ordinance 2021-05, Adding Chapter 1.18 of the Encinitas Municipal Code Regarding Custody and Use of the City Seal, City Logo, and City Insignia. Contact Person: IT Manager Flynn
Conduct second reading and adopt Ordinance 2021-05, entitled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas California Amending Encinitas Municipal Code by Adding Chapter 1.18 Establishing Regulations for Custody and Use of the City Seal, City Logo, and City Insignia."
2021-05-26 Item 08J Adoption of Ordinance for Use of City Seal and Logo
8K.
List of Projects funded by SB1 (The Road Repair and Accountability Act of 2017) for Fiscal Year 2021-22. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
The Road Repair and Accountability Act of 2017” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-05-26 Item 08K SB1 Projects FY 2021-22
8L.
Adoption of Ordinance 2021-06 establishing a new speed limit on Lake Drive. Contact Person: Engineering Specialist Barr
Adopt Ordinance 2021-06, entitled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Establishing Speed Limit on Lake Drive.” Establishes a new Speed Limit of 35 mph on Lake Drive between Birmingham Drive and Wales Drive.
2021-05-26 Item 08L Lake Drive Speed Limit Ordinance Adoption
8M.
Fiscal Year 2020-21 Third Quarter Budget Status Report and Proposed Budget Amendments. Contact Person: Assistant Director of Finance Gallup
1) Receive and file the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Third Quarter Budget Status Report; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-41 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-05-26 Item 08M Third Quarter Budget Report
8N.
*Public Hearing to Receive Testimony Regarding the FY 2021-22 Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
1) Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the FY 2021-22 Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District (ELLD) Annual Engineer's Report; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-22 entitled, "Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Renewing the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District (Zones A, B, C, D, E, F, G & H), confirming the FY 2021-22 Engineer's Report and ordering the transmission of charges to the County Auditor for collection" (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-05-26 Item 08N ELLD FY 2021-22 Public Hearing
8O.
Rescinding Resolution 2020-45 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) Establishing All-Way Stop Control At Multiple Locations Throughout the City and Adopt Resolution 2021-51 (Attachment 2 of the agenda report) establishing All-Way Stop Control at Multiple Locations throughout the City. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Staff recommends rescinding Resolution 2020-45 Establishing All-Way Stop Control At Multiple Locations Throughout the City and Adopting Resolution 2021-51 Establishing All-Way Stop Control At Multiple Locations throughout the City.
2021-05-26 Item 08O Rescinding Resolution 2020-45 All Way Stop Control
8P.
City Council review and consideration of the continuation of the Jewish Family Service (JFS) Safe Parking Program at Leichtag Commons located at 441 Saxony Road for a maximum of 25 vehicles accommodating households living in their cars for an additional six months. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
1) Consider authorization of extension of the JFS Safe Parking Program. If proposing an extension of the Program, adopt Resolution No. 2021-47 “Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Extending the Existence of a Shelter Crisis and Taking Actions to Continue the Safe Parking Program.” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); 2) Approve the Amendment to the Term of the Lease Agreement between the City of Encinitas and LF Encinitas Properties, LLC (“Leichtag Foundation”) as attached in substantial form, subject to review and final approval by City Attorney, for the purpose of leasing a portion of Leichtag Commons to provide a Safe Parking Program Lot and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement. (Attachment 2 of the agenda report); and 3) Approve the Amendment to the Term of the Use Agreement between the City of Encinitas and Jewish Family Service, as attached in substantial form, subject to review and final approval by City Attorney, for the purpose of operating a Safe Parking Program, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement (Attachment 3 of the agenda report).
2021-05-26 Item 08P Safe Parking Extension
2021-05-26 Item 08P Safe Parking - Public Comments Received as of 05-25
2021-05-26 Item 08P Safe Parking - Public Comments Received Until Noon on 05-26
8Q.
First Amended Restatement of Agreement Between Cardiff Sanitation District and Solana Beach Sanitation District Establishing the San Elijo Joint Powers Authority. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
Adopt Resolution 2021-38 Approving First Amended Restatement of Agreement Between Cardiff Sanitation District and Solana Beach Sanitation District Establishing the San Elijo Joint Powers Authority.
2021-05-26 Item 08Q SEJPA Restatement of Agreement
8R.
Refunding of the Encinitas Public Financing Authority, 2014 Lease Revenue Bonds (Pacific View Property and Moonlight Beach Lifeguard Tower), Series B (Taxable). Contact Person: Finance Director McBroome
1) Approve the refinancing plan for the Encinitas Public Financing Authority (EPFA) 2014 Lease Revenue Bonds (Pacific View Property and Moonlight Beach Lifeguard Tower), Series B (Taxable); 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute a professional services agreement as shown in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, in consultation with the City Attorney, with Best Best & Krieger LLP as Bond and Disclosure Counsel for a contract amount of $66,500; 3) Authorize the City Manager to execute a professional services agreement as shown in Attachment 2 of the agenda report, in consultation with the City Attorney, with Fieldman Rolapp and Associates, Inc. as Financial Advisor for a total not to exceed contract cost of $300,000, over five years if all options are taken; and 4) Authorize the Director of Finance to approve the payment of expenses incurred with respect to the preparation and delivery of the refunding bonds.
2021-05-26 Item 08R EPFA Consideration of Refunding 2014 Bonds
8S.
Consideration of Refunding the City of Encinitas Community Facilities District #1 (Encinitas Ranch Public Improvements) 2012 Special Tax Refunding Bonds. Contact Person: Finance Director McBroome
1) Approve the refinancing plan for the Encinitas Community Facilities District (CFD) #1 2012 Special Tax Refunding Bonds (2012 Bonds); 2) Authorize the City Manager to executive a professional services agreement as shown in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, in consultation with City Attorney, with Best Best & Krieger LLP as Bond and Disclosure Counsel for a contract amount of $81,500; 3) Authorize the City Manager to executive an addendum services agreement as shown in Attachment 2 of the agenda report, in consultation with City Attorney, with Scott Associates for the services of Special Tax Administrator during the issuance of Refunding Bonds for a contract amount of $37,500 and a total not to exceed contract cost of $186,674; 4) Authorize the City Manager, City Attorney and Director of Finance to work with Fieldman Rolapp and Associates, Inc. as Financial Advisor; and 5) Authorize the Director of Finance to approve the payment of expenses incurred with respect to the preparation and delivery of the refunding bonds.
2021-05-26 Item 08S Community Facility District #1 2012 Bond Refinancing

Introduce draft Ordinance No. 2021-07 titled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Repealing Ordinance No. 2020-09 Relating to Density Bonus in Its Entirety and Reinstating Zoning Code Language Existing Prior to Adoption of Ordinance No. 2020-09.”

Final Report on the Mobility Enhancement Study on Rancho Santa Fe Road. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Receive the final Rancho Santa Fe Road Phase 2 Corridor Study Report.

Safety and Mobility Enhancements at the Intersection of Vulcan Avenue and La Costa Avenue. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Bandegan
1) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-49 Approval of an All-Way Stop Control at the intersection of Vulcan Avenue and La Costa Avenue (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); 2) Provide direction to staff on improving the Vulcan Avenue/La Costa Intersection; and 3) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-50 Approval of Design for the New Walkway on La Costa Avenue between Vulcan Avenue and the La Costa Bridge (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
